summary: Frontend test of VIP page (/ranks) after Date-serialization fix in server/app.ts removeSensitiveFields. Logged in through POST /api/login (in browser context), went to /ranks. Every requested check passed: the page renders with no crash and no 'VIP status unavailable' state, the VIP badge shows, the 'VIP progress this month' section and all 4 stat cards appear, Daily free CC allowance = 2, 'VIP benefits are active' line appears, and the pool reset text reads 'Resets Oct 21, 2026, 12:00 AM UTC'. Refresh button re-fetches /api/user/rank (200) and the page still renders correctly. No page JS errors. Regression check: /api/user returns createdAt/termsAcceptedAt as ISO strings and does not include a password field; /api/user/rank poolResetAt = '2026-10-21T00:00:00.000Z'.

issues: RanksPage elements have no data-testid attributes (I had to use text/role selectors)
Today's pool left shows 0 while Remaining shows 2. This may be valid data (global pool empty), but the UI does not explain it to the user

action_items: Optional: add data-testid attributes to RanksPage stat cards, badge and Refresh button
Optional: explain the case where pool left = 0 but remaining claims > 0
critical_code_review_comments: removeSensitiveFields fix is correct: it only sanitizes plain objects, so Date and other class instances pass through to JSON.stringify unchanged
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth: POST /api/login JSON {email,password} with credentials:'include' from the browser page, then navigate to /ranks. Captcha is client-side only.
